records.text: Maroon is associated with military airborne forces in the United Kingdom, United States, France, and dozens of other militaries
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep DqGNvi36ol8)

appearances.snippet: One person wrote, quote, airborne forces wear maroon not just in the UK, the USA, and France, as well as in dozens of other militaries.

verification.notes: The episode exactly preserves the anonymous email claim. British and U.S. Army sources call maroon an international symbol of airborne forces. The French defense ministry describes French parachutists’ beret as red, with one regiment using amaranth terminology, and the cited official sources do not establish the claimed count of dozens of militaries. The broad association is supported, but the France wording and numerical scope remain qualified.
